params.1273: Hunt implings in RuneScape, or go to Puro-Puro to hunt them in their native habitat.
params.1292: Gives experience and a variety of material rewards.
params.1274: Entering Puro-Puro through a crop circle in a wheat field outside Zanaris will aid your impling hunting endeavours.
params.1275: Talk to the wandering impling by the Zanaris crop circle to learn more.
